dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of dishes are you looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: Simpler dishes do a better job at revealing the chef's true mastery over the culinary arts.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: For example, these Egg Rolls from the Kiminami Restaurant. The dish needs to be at least of this level for it to be worthy of my critique.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: If you can't make something of this level, then I suggest you give up, as you are only wasting my time.
